title: A batch gate whose verified-commit probe hangs in setup still settles
description: Runs the real gate over ports whose clock the case controls and a verified-commit probe whose setup never reaches its test runner: the probe is stopped at the trial's five-minute per-step bound, releases its heavy-job slot, counts as failed on the verified commit, and the gate settles instead of timing out (GY-3659).

steps.name: a hanging probe setup stops at the per-step bound and the gate settles
